lessons_learned: Lesson learned: Browser-driven archival exposed silent backend/AI failures invisible to API-seeded scripts: Multer default fields=10 blocking 12+ metadata fields, shared 25MB limit blocking 37-40MB PDFs, extractText invoking full-table OCR without mode='metadata', _run_inprocess_index passing raw kwargs instead of IndexRequest(...), embeddings.py overwriting SentenceTransformer.max_seq_length=8192 on 512-token all-MiniLM-L6-v2, GET /archive/search rejecting limit>50 during dedup, and SophisticatedDocumentViewer fetching /submissions/archive-document/file on in-memory DOCX blobs.

Prevention runbook/checklist: Follow .agents/skills/archive-browser-batch-ingestion/SKILL.md: keep MAX_ARCHIVE_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB=50 separate from MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB=25, cap SentenceTransformer max_seq_length to model max_position_embeddings, paginate dedup searches with limit<=50, run sequential 5-paper Playwright slices using domcontentloaded, and verify ChromaDB + live /browser document viewers.
